name: Cross-Brand Audit
summary: A reusable paired Codex/Claude read-only audit with peer interrogation and orchestrator closeout.

combo.description: Fan out cross-brand scans, challenge each report with the peer's blind spots, then consolidate and close review reports explicitly.

phases.title: Codex Audit
phases.action: Launch a read-only Codex audit over the assigned scope.
phases.verifier: Worker report includes findings, evidence inspected, limits, and recommended verdict.
phases.stop_condition: Codex report is bridged into the ledger.

phases.title: Claude Audit
phases.action: Launch a read-only Claude audit over the assigned scope.
phases.verifier: Worker report includes findings, evidence inspected, limits, and recommended verdict.
phases.stop_condition: Claude report is bridged into the ledger.

phases.title: Peer Interrogation
phases.action: Ask each brand to address the strongest contrary or missing findings from the other brand.
phases.command: uaf runtime message --latest --from orchestrator --message "Compare your report against the peer report and state what you missed, concede, or dispute with evidence." --detach
phases.verifier: Interrogation responses are bridged and reviewed as claims.
phases.stop_condition: Disputed and conceded findings are explicit.

phases.title: Audit Rollup
phases.action: Consolidate accepted findings into a severity-ordered plan and close every worker report with a decision.
phases.verifier: Every worker report has an orchestrator decision, and accepted fixes have verifier targets.
phases.stop_condition: The audit can drive implementation without unresolved report queues.
